why: llama.cpp's OpenAI-compatible server, llama-server. It serves GGUF on Metal, CUDA or the CPU, and sizes its own context and GPU layers to fit the machine, so a profile needs only the model. MODEL is passed as --alias too, so /v1/models reports exactly MODEL whether the model comes from the Hub or a file. It checks an API key, which it reads from LLAMA_API_KEY so the key is on no command line; with one set it binds every interface, and without one it stays on 127.0.0.1. It downloads a repo's GGUF itself, and its /health answers 200 only once the model is loaded.

notes.hybrid: llama.cpp can reuse a cached prompt on this model only up to the start of a user message, so keep the system prompt and tools identical between chats.
